notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
In recent news, the Cowardly Knughts team has expanded! We are working on our next title which will be revealed to everyone as soon as the Steam Page is finished!

We have not forgotten about Cartier 06 and thought about switching up the scenery to a summertime vibe.

We have also added the interior of the casino, and a playable mini-game inside.

Please note that our main focus is the upcoming title and that is the reason Cartier updates will be further in time from each other, but dont worry, we will keep improving all our games for many years to come!

The full patch note can be found below :

Fixes:
- Texture related issue around the graveyard fixed
- Collision errors regarding some vehicles

Content :
- Switched the cop cars to Dacias
- Added Casino interior
- Added Casino mini-game
- switched scenery to Summer

notes.title: Optimization and Bug Fix
notes.content:
Optimized the settings of the game
Fixed issue with cat movement
Fixed issue where you couldn't pick up the bullets

notes.title: Bug Fixes all around
notes.content:
Fixed issue where one of the doors of the apartment complex opened when it should not.
Fixed an issue with the cat not being able to stop crouching.
Fixed problem with missing textures on a few plant items.
Fixed Dog- You can now pet him. He did not like being taken off of Unreal 5.4, and made a fuss on Unreal 5.5 but we managed to convince him to be friendly again.
Tweaked the Battery achievement.
Tweaked Lockpicking to be slightly easier.

notes.title: Optimizations
notes.content:
This patch note brings you new optimizations and bug fixes.
We have updated the engine version to the Unreal 5.5 and have fixed a few underlying issues with the core level. 

Full Patch Notes : 
- Fixed reflection lag
- Fixed a few branches sticking out of the ground 
- Fixed the ground collision in certain areas of the game
- Optimized a variety of meshes with nanite and converted various textures into virtual textures
- Changed the weather in 2 of the scenes.
- Updated to Unreal 5.5
- Optimized the game with a few new graphical settings which will not affect the visual quality.

notes.title: Winter has come to Cartier 06!
notes.content:
Winter has officially arrived in Cartier 06, transforming the atmosphere with a blanket of snow and a sprinkle of mystery. As you explore the chilly streets, you’ll notice snow softly falling, adding a serene and immersive touch to your adventure. But that’s not all—we’ve hidden a few special treasures around the apartment for you to discover. Can you find them all?

In addition to these seasonal updates, we’ve addressed some key issues to ensure a smoother gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new in this update:

A Few Hidden Gems: Keep your eyes peeled for surprises scattered around the apartment.
Snowfall: Light snow now graces the streets, enhancing the winter vibe.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a health issue in one of the save files.
Resolved an issue where looking downward caused players to see through their character’s body.

notes.title: Fixed broken save
notes.content:
Fixed the broken save file people found.
Your save might be corrupted and you might be forced to go back one save (to the GAS Station).
For anyone playing the game from the start, the save file will not be broken.

notes.title: Fixed few things
notes.content:
Bug Fixes :
- Loading error in certain areas
- Lighting error in certain areas
- Fixed Broken Save Point

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optimization
notes.content:
Bug Fixes : 
- Various lighting fixes across the main scene
- Various mesh fixes
- Night time lighting tweak
- Collision fixes across the scene
- Tweaked Artificial intelligence, making it more difficult at times.
- Removed broken save point
- Fixed a few texture files being too inconsistent

Optimizations : 
- Optimized the indoors with better  meshes
- Optimized lighting indoors
- Added new Lighting mode under (Global Illumination - OFF) that will perform better on lower end devices.
- Added a "Low" preset for the Global Illumination that will be more performant.
- Optimized the main thread

Additions :
- Added an extra autosave where needed
- Added a new interaction where needed
- Added a new pointer where needed
- Added a few missing localization words
- Added in-game UI to one of the puzzles
